summary: VSee Health, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a note financing. On June 8, 2026, it entered a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor, issuing an 8% OID secured promissory note with an aggregate principal amount of $271,739.13 (including $21,739.13 OID). The note carries an 18% interest rate, matures December 8, 2026, and is prepayable with a 10% fee; mandatory repayment occurs upon proceeds from an equity line with the same holder. The note is secured by certain assets under a security agreement. No equity or M&A implications; this is a high-cost debt arrangement typical for distressed liquidity. Watch for default acceleration triggers.
